sources.title: kimimaro · PyPI
sources.snippet: Kimimaro was designed for use with high resolution neurons extracted from electron microscopy data via AI segmentation, but it can be applied to many different fields. On an Apple Silicon M1 arm64 chip (Firestorm cores 3.2 GHz max frequency), this package processed a 512x512x100 volume with 333 labels in 20 seconds.
